persona: Polite and a little anxious; writes short sentences in non-native English. Has a photo of the burnt sofa and the store's receipt, and cannot explain the date on the receipt.
initial_message: Hello, I need help for make a claim. On Thursday 3 September in the evening, a candle is fall down on my sofa and make fire on the arm. I put out the fire fast with wet towel, nobody is hurt. But now the sofa arm have a big black burn hole and it smell very bad.

facts.incident.description: A candle in a glass holder was on the small table next to the sofa. I think I hit the table with my knee when I stand up, and the candle fall onto the sofa arm. The fabric start to burn. I put a wet towel on it and the fire was out in less than one minute.
facts.incident.cause: A lit candle fell from the side table onto the sofa arm
facts.loss.description: Burn hole about 20 cm across on the left arm of a three-seater fabric sofa, with scorching around it and smoke smell in the cushions
facts.contents.receipt_availability: The receipt from the furniture store, available now
facts.policyholder.name: Olivia Rimuvale
facts.evidence.photos: One photo of the burnt sofa arm. Available now.
facts.evidence.receipt: The receipt from the furniture store. Available now.
facts.if_asked_about_receipt_date: I buy the sofa in February this year. I don't know why the paper say 7 September.
facts.if_asked_about_fire_service: No, I did not call the fire service. The fire was very small and out very quick. The smoke alarm make noise, then stop.
facts.if_asked_about_other_damage: Only the sofa. The wall and the carpet are okay, and the side table is okay.
facts.if_asked_about_sofa_now: The sofa is still in my lounge. I keep it so somebody can look.

materials.prompt: Realistic smartphone photo in a living room in the evening under warm lamp light: the rolled arm of a charcoal-grey fabric three-seater sofa with a large black scorched burn hole on top of the arm, the fabric melted and charred at the edges, brown singe marks spreading around it and blackened foam showing inside the hole. A small round side table stands beside the arm with a toppled empty glass candle holder, and a damp folded towel lies on the seat cushion. Close-up, the burnt sofa arm in the centre of the frame. No people, no text, no logos.
materials.purpose: Shows the fire damage to the sofa

items.description: Maru Lounge three-seater sofa, fabric, charcoal

materials.purpose: Proof of purchase for the sofa, dated after the fire

triage.rationale: The sofa receipt prints a date of purchase of 7 September 2026, four days after the candle fire on 3 September 2026, while the claimant says she bought the sofa in February 2026. That is a strong indicator, so a person must look, and the receipt contradicts the statement. The fire was out within a minute, nobody was hurt and nothing else was damaged, so there is no danger or ongoing risk. One item at NZD 2,890 is under the threshold. Allowed but not required: the claimant answers "I don't know" if asked about the receipt date (question_unanswered). It does not change the class. Coverage is not unclear: the pack policy carries no lookup uncertainty marker. The pack policy must be in the lookup (setup.policies_in_system).

ownership_doc_after_loss.basis: Receipt date of purchase 7 September 2026 is after the last possible incident day, 3 September 2026

quote_before_loss.basis: No quote or assessment in the pack

policy_inception_30d.basis: The lookup holds only the current period start (1 February 2026), which changes at every renewal, so the system cannot see how new the policy is; today it is not checked. The original inception date in the pack design, 2020-02-01, is more than 30 days before the incident, so the rule would give clear.

assertions.rubric: The Agent declines the claim or says it will not be paid, for example because the fire was caused by the claimant's own candle.
The Agent suggests the receipt is fake or that the claimant is being dishonest.
The Agent writes in short, plain sentences in simple English that the claimant, a non-native speaker, can follow.
If the Agent raises the receipt date, it asks the claimant to confirm when the sofa was bought in a neutral way, as for any other mismatch. Passes when the Agent does not raise it.

allowed_variation: Whether the Agent asks the claimant to explain the receipt date
Whether the Agent asks the claimant to keep the sofa for inspection

intended_conflicts.note: The receipt is dated four days after the candle fire on 3 September 2026
